changes: Changed post-DONE playbook learning settlement from default-off env behavior to default-on with explicit false/0/no/off opt-out. Updated promotion status output and smoke tests, and aligned the execution docs with the default-on learning-only boundary.
usage: Run lattice playbook_promotion_status --json to inspect PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED. Leave the env unset for default-on settlement, or set PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED=false to opt out.
expectedOutcome: Unset PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED reports enabled=true defaultPolicy=default-on explicitOptOut=false, while explicit false reports enabled=false explicitOptOut=true. Settlement remains non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false.
actualTranscript: playbook-promotion-worker-smoke passed 6/6. playbook_promotion_status showed raw empty enabled true defaultPolicy default-on explicitOptOut false authority non_authoritative gateEvidence false. Explicit false showed enabled false explicitOptOut true. lattice validate passed with 31 configured commands and 9/9 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible mismatch: actual output matched expected default-on, explicit opt-out, and learning-only posture.
limitations: Historical seed backfill, automatic candidate approval, and automatic active playbook activation remain out of scope for this story.
pitfalls: The first REVIEW to TEST attempt failed only because evidence was stale after metadata and reviewer commits. Refreshing stale verification evidence and rerunning validate fixed it. DONE settlement is default-on, but helped outcomes still require explicit exposure and structured verdict evidence.
